g.text: SD05 - Follow up prospective customer (AD20 / AD21)
visit recorded with date and contact information
companies without orders visited at least one month ago, contact person and details
Only contacts in this overview are eligible for follow-up.
[At least one month has elapsed and no order exists]
Call and offer 10% extra on first order
interest and permission to create account
Transfer company, billing/delivery addresses and incentive
Record outcome and close follow-up without more contact.
[Already ordered or follow-up not yet due]
